label: Понять
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for понять (to understand, grasp).

missions.phrase: Теперь я наконец пойму эту задачу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person. 'Пойму' is the я-form of perfective понять, built on the irregular stem пойм-, and carries future meaning. The imperfective partner is понимать.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person. 'Поймёшь' takes the -ёшь ending on the stem пойм-. Because понять is perfective, this single form expresses a completed future realization.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person singular. 'Поймёт' is the он-form ending in -ёт. 'Сразу' stresses that the understanding will be instant and complete.

missions.phrase: Вместе мы поймём этот трудный текст.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Поймём' shows the мы-form ending -ём on stem пойм-. 'Вместе' frames a shared act of grasping the text.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Поймут' is the они-form with the -ут ending. As a perfective, it points to a single finished moment of understanding.

missions.phrase: Я сразу понял твою главную мысль.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Понял' is the masculine singular past of perfective понять, with stress on the first syllable. It reports a completed act of comprehension.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Поняла' adds the feminine -а ending and shifts stress to the final syllable, a common irregularity. 'Наконец' marks the long-awaited result.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Поняли' is the plural past form ending in -и, with stress back on the stem. It states that the whole group grasped the task at once.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Пойми' is the informal command of perfective понять. The fixed phrase 'пойми меня правильно' asks one person to take your meaning the right way.

missions.phrase: Я очень хочу понять этот язык.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Modal infinitive use. 'Хочу' governs the bare infinitive 'понять', the perfective form. The sentence frames a goal of fully grasping the language.
